title: Zip Lining At Mosi Tampa!!! (8.21.12)
description:
I went to tampa and met a few friends to do the zip line and ropes course at the Mosi in Tampa!
Hello, I am TheTimTracker. Welcome to my crazy beard and mustache driven life!
